mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Symptomatic control of a network state measured in slices; not deep recovery; developmental benefit not implied. Track B: no allele-specific datum.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: Memantine (NMDA-receptor channel blocker, approved), represented here ONLY through the competitive antagonist d-APV used as a tool in the one WWOX source; no memantine datum exists in any WWOX system. Map record R-02.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Network hyperexcitability (CLAIM 021) in a neuron-specific Wwox deletion; transfer to the reference genotype is moderate at best (CLAIM 021 transferability T2) and the intervention arm is a tool compound, not the drug.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NON_TROVATO_NELLA_RICERCA as a test of memantine in a WWOX system; the NMDA-receptor dependence itself is measured (d-APV). No new query was run for this card.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: Map R-02 class PROMISING_BUT_MECHANISTIC_GAP; CLAIM 021, CLAIM 031.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A (allele-blind); symptomatic network control, not deep recovery.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. A reduction of the burst state is the only expectation; no developmental benefit is implied.
p4_card.mechanism: Target: NMDA receptors; direction: block; context: acute neocortical slice from neuron-specific knockout mice. The dependence of the burst and of the delayed evoked response on NMDA receptors is measured with d-APV.

external_not_wwox_evidence: d-APV is the tool compound in the WWOX source; memantine's own pharmacology is class-level knowledge from map record R-02 and is not re-sourced here

for: Bursts eliminated and the delayed evoked response suppressed under an NMDA-receptor antagonist in knockout slices.
against: The tool compound is not memantine: competitive versus uncompetitive antagonism, a slice preparation versus a living brain, and no exposure relation.

The paper's own burst-frequency numbers disagree between the main text and its supplementary table (entries 23, 24); the heterozygote incidence is a sixth of the knockout's and is called similar (entries 0, 1).

The control arm of the synaptic analyses pools heterozygotes with wild type under a conditional rule the paper does not show for the pooled measures (CLAIM 021 caveat; entry 9); the incidence figures used here keep wild type separate.

The same figure's pannexin-1 blocker raised burst frequency about two and a half fold with no significance reported, which both text and Discussion call no effect (entry 2): a lesson that this paper's prose and panels disagree and the panel must be read.
Suppressing a network state is not correcting a developmental lesion (CLAIM 031).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Slice at postnatal days 13 to 17, neuron-specific deletion, tool compound versus drug; paediatric neurodevelopmental risk of chronic blockade is a class-level concern.

p4_card.pharmacology: Approved CNS-active compound (class level, map record R-02); exposure relation to the slice concentration of the tool compound: UNKNOWN.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: The statement that a tool-compound result does not transfer to memantine is INFERENZA and is owed a blind audit by another actor.

p4_card.next_measurement: Multi-electrode recording on Wwox-null neurons or organoids: does memantine (or MK-801) reduce spontaneous burst frequency and amplitude and phase-amplitude coupling dose-dependently, with the parental or rescue line as the internal comparator.
p4_card.status_reason: Only the dependence is measured; the drug has not been tested.
p4_card.value_added: Separates the measured NMDA-receptor dependence of the burst from any statement about memantine, and names the experiment that would join them.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

not_known: Whether memantine itself reduces the burst frequency, duration, amplitude or phase-amplitude coupling in any Wwox-deficient preparation (it has never been given to one).
Whether the d-APV dependence holds with a low-affinity uncompetitive blocker at exposures tolerated in a child, and with the parental or rescue line as the internal comparator.
Whether the burst is a driver of the developmental phenotype or a network state on top of it (CLAIM 031: symptomatic control does not buy development).
Whether chronic NMDA-receptor blockade in a developing brain is acceptable where WWOX loss already impairs activity-dependent maturation (class-level concern in map record R-02, unsourced here).
Whether the effect transfers from a neuron-specific deletion at postnatal days 13 to 17 in a slice to a human epileptic encephalopathy.
Human-genetics corroboration (GRIN2A, an NMDA-receptor subunit, among burst-suppression genes; DL-MECH-002) is carried as context only: it was not re-read for this card.
evidence_against: The tool compound is not memantine: competitive versus uncompetitive antagonism, a slice preparation versus a living brain, and no exposure relation.

The control arm of the synaptic analyses pools heterozygotes with wild type under a conditional rule the paper does not show for the pooled measures (CLAIM 021 caveat; entry 9); the incidence figures used here keep wild type separate.

The same figure's pannexin-1 blocker raised burst frequency about two and a half fold with no significance reported, which both text and Discussion call no effect (entry 2): a lesson that this paper's prose and panels disagree and the panel must be read.
Suppressing a network state is not correcting a developmental lesion (CLAIM 031).

reading_guard: OPPOSES_DISEASE_CHANGE here compares the sign of a burst measure under a competitive NMDA-receptor antagonist (a tool compound) with the knockout-versus-wild-type sign. It is NOT a comparison for memantine, which has never been given to a WWOX system, and it says nothing about exposure, tolerability, the Q230P class, development, efficacy or safety in any person.
card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
A genetic or tool-compound row is not a row for the named drug: the identity of what was given is written in each assertion.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations and vector quantities of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card. Locators are existing entries of the deep-dive manifest PMID34634460.json; the d-APV Results sentence is quoted from the article text in the declared artifact.
